timezone_windows.note: Sampler runs every 30 minutes and only requests routes on local weekdays during that city's AM and PM rush windows (15-minute grace after each window end for a late cron). Weekends are skipped. Inclusive 30-minute slots are used for the monthly call budget; grace slots are not extra planned samples.

las-vegas.sources: FAST signal timing AM 6:30–9:15; PM core within RTC CMP/PHED 3–7 p.m. and UCR 4–7 p.m. Sampler uses 6:30–9:30 a.m. and 3:30–6:30 p.m. PT (FAST PM plans can run 2–7, which is too wide for a commute sampler).

nashville.sources: TDOT Inner Loop PEL / HOV 7–9 a.m. and 4–6 p.m. Mon–Fri (including I-40 east and I-65 south); ATRI/news I-40 at I-65 backups ~3–6 p.m. Sampler uses 7:00–9:30 a.m. and 3:30–6:30 p.m. CT.

orlando.sources: MetroPlan/City TIA standard 7–9 a.m. and 4–6 p.m.; MetroPlan Orlando MTP 2050 Ch. 4 (adopted Dec 10, 2025) documents PM spreading to ~4:30–6:30. Sampler uses 7:00–9:30 a.m. and 4:00–6:30 p.m. ET.
